prompt:
Find the Raspberry Pi Foundation's or Raspberry Pi Ltd's official statement about how long the Raspberry Pi 5 will remain in production. Cite the official page and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided web search results, the official statement regarding the Raspberry Pi 5's production lifetime comes from Raspberry Pi Ltd's product pages and datasheets.

SOURCE: https://www.raspberrypi.com/products/raspberry-pi-5/?resellerType=industry | QUOTE: "Raspberry Pi 5 will remain in production until at least January 2036" | CLAIM: The Raspberry Pi 5 has a minimum production lifetime guarantee.

SOURCE: https://pip-assets.raspberrypi.com/categories/892-raspberry-pi-5/documents/RP-008348-DS-8-raspberry-pi-5-product-brief.pdf | QUOTE: "Production lifetime Raspberry Pi 5 will remain in production until at least January 2036" | CLAIM: The official product brief confirms the January 2036 production date.

SOURCE: https://www.raspberrypi.com/news/raspberry-pis-commitment-to-longevity-a-sustainable-advantage/ | QUOTE: "Take the flagship Raspberry Pi 5, for example: it has a guaranteed minimum manufacturing end date of January 2038" | CLAIM: A news article on the official Raspberry Pi website cites an even longer guaranteed manufacturing date of January 2038.

The official product specification pages cite January 2036, while a more recent news article on their official site extends that commitment to January 2038. This suggests the official guarantee may have been extended.
